title: Burns Cottage
geometryBasis: The named OSM building way controls the crooked plan. The national designation and Qualla photograph establish the asymmetry, opening types and continuous thatch.
sectionBasis: Historic Environment Scotland records a single storey, seven entrance bays, five rear bays, whitewashed harled clay walls, reed thatch with deep coping, wooden ridge and rendered stacks.
limitations: The preserved cottage including the attached agricultural bays. Freestanding wall, museum grounds and interiors lie outside the model scope.
Individual sill and stack heights are estimated from the photograph and heritage description.
